name: m2-01-1
title: The whole journey in one picture
spec:
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant U as curl (user space)
  participant K as Linux kernel (stack)
  participant N as NIC / switch / router path
  participant D as DNS resolver
  participant S as Server (example.com)
  U->>K: getaddrinfo("example.com") - resolver library, /etc/nsswitch.conf, /etc/hosts
  K->>D: DNS query (UDP/53) to configured resolver, via routing + ARP/ND + Ethernet
  D-->>K: A / AAAA records (IP addresses, TTL)
  U->>K: socket(), connect(IP:443)
  K->>K: route lookup (longest prefix), source address, ARP/ND for next hop
  K->>S: TCP SYN
  S-->>K: SYN-ACK
  K->>S: ACK (connection established)
  U->>S: TLS ClientHello (SNI, ALPN)
  S-->>U: ServerHello, certificate chain, key share, Finished
  U->>S: Finished (TLS 1.3: encrypted application data may follow)
  U->>S: HTTP request: GET / HTTP/1.1 (or HTTP/2)
  S-->>U: HTTP response: status, headers, body
  U->>S: FIN / close (or connection reuse)

name: m2-02-1
title: The DoD / TCP/IP model (4 layers)
spec:
flowchart TB
  subgraph TCPIP["TCP/IP (DoD) model"]
    A["Application: HTTP, DNS, SSH, TLS, NFS, gRPC"]
    T["Transport: TCP, UDP (ports; reliability, flow control)"]
    I["Internet: IPv4, IPv6, ICMP (addresses, routing, fragmentation)"]
    L["Link (network access): Ethernet, Wi-Fi, PPP; physical signalling"]
    A --- T --- I --- L
  end

name: m2-02-2
title: The OSI model (7 layers)
spec:
flowchart TB
  L7["7 Application: user-facing protocols"] --- L6["6 Presentation: encoding, encryption, compression"] --- L5["5 Session: dialogue/session management"] --- L4["4 Transport: end-to-end delivery (TCP, UDP)"] --- L3["3 Network: addressing and routing (IP)"] --- L2["2 Data link: frames on one link, MAC addresses (Ethernet)"] --- L1["1 Physical: signals on the medium (cables, optics, radio)"]

name: m2-02-3
title: Encapsulation and decapsulation
spec:
flowchart TB
  APP["Application data: 'GET / HTTP/1.1 ...' (e.g. 1,000 bytes)"] --> TLS["(TLS record: + 5-byte header + 16-byte tag)"]
  TLS --> TCP["TCP segment = TCP header (20-60 B) + payload"]
  TCP --> IP["IP packet = IP header (IPv4 20-60 B / IPv6 40 B) + segment"]
  IP --> ETH["Ethernet frame = dst MAC (6) + src MAC (6) + [802.1Q tag 4] + EtherType (2) + packet + FCS (4)"]
  ETH --> PHY["On the wire: preamble (7) + SFD (1) + frame + inter-frame gap (12 byte times)"]

name: m2-02-4
title: The hourglass (wasp waist)
spec:
flowchart TB
  subgraph APPS["Many application protocols"]
    HTTP["HTTP"]; DNS["DNS"]; SSH["SSH"]; NFS["NFS"]; GRPC["gRPC"]; NCCL["NCCL (over TCP/RDMA)"]
  end
  TR["TCP / UDP / QUIC (few)"]
  IPN["IP (exactly one, plus its IPv6 version)"]
  subgraph LINKS["Many link technologies"]
    ETH["Ethernet"]; WIFI["Wi-Fi"]; SAT["Satellite"]; PPP["PPP/LTE/5G"]; IB["IPoIB"]
  end
  APPS --> TR --> IPN --> LINKS

name: m2-02-5
title: The Linux stack
spec:
flowchart TB
  APP["Application (user space): socket API (socket, bind, listen, connect, send, recv, epoll)"] --> SOCK["Socket layer: struct socket / sock; send and receive buffers (sk_buff queues)"]
  SOCK --> L4["TCP / UDP / SCTP / QUIC-in-userspace: connection state, retransmit timers, congestion control"]
  L4 --> L3["IP: routing (FIB), netfilter hooks (PREROUTING, INPUT, FORWARD, OUTPUT, POSTROUTING), fragmentation, IPsec/XFRM"]
  L3 --> QD["Traffic control: qdisc (fq_codel, fq, mq, htb, tbf), tc filters, eBPF (tc, cgroup, XDP)"]
  QD --> DRV["Device driver / NIC: TX/RX rings (DMA), NAPI polling, interrupts, RSS queues, offloads (checksum, TSO/GSO/GRO, VLAN, VXLAN)"]
  DRV --> WIRE["Wire / fiber / virtual device (virtio, veth, vxlan, bridge, bond, tun)"]
  RDMA["RDMA verbs (libibverbs): memory registration, QPs, CQs - NIC hardware transport"] -. "bypasses sockets, TCP/IP, qdisc" .-> WIRE

name: m2-03-1
title: Learning, forwarding and flooding
spec:
sequenceDiagram
  participant A as Host A (MAC a, port 1)
  participant S as Switch
  participant B as Host B (MAC b, port 2)
  participant C as Host C (MAC c, port 3)
  A->>S: frame src=a dst=b (b unknown)
  Note over S: learn a→port1, unknown unicast: FLOOD to ports 2,3
  S->>B: frame (accepted)
  S->>C: frame (ignored: not its MAC)
  B->>S: reply src=b dst=a
  Note over S: learn b→port2, a known: forward only to port 1
  S->>A: reply
  A->>S: next frame src=a dst=b
  Note over S: both known: forward only to port 2
  S->>B: frame

name: m2-06-1
title: The TCP header and options
spec:
flowchart LR
  subgraph H["TCP header (20 bytes + options)"]
    direction TB
    A["Source port (16) | Destination port (16)"]
    B["Sequence number (32)"]
    C["Acknowledgement number (32)"]
    D["Data offset (4) | Reserved | Flags: CWR ECE URG ACK PSH RST SYN FIN | Window (16)"]
    E["Checksum (16) | Urgent pointer (16)"]
    F["Options (TLV, up to 40 bytes): MSS, window scale, SACK-permitted, SACK blocks, timestamps, fast open"]
  end

name: m2-06-2
title: The handshake, data transfer and teardown
spec:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client (CLOSED)
  participant S as Server (LISTEN)
  C->>S: SYN seq=x, MSS, WS, SACK-perm, TS  (client → SYN_SENT)
  S->>C: SYN+ACK seq=y ack=x+1, options  (server → SYN_RCVD)
  C->>S: ACK ack=y+1  (client → ESTABLISHED, server → ESTABLISHED)
  Note over C,S: data: segments with seq, ACKs cumulative / selective
  C->>S: FIN seq=m  (client → FIN_WAIT_1)
  S->>C: ACK  (client → FIN_WAIT_2, server → CLOSE_WAIT)
  S->>C: FIN  (server → LAST_ACK)
  C->>S: ACK  (client → TIME_WAIT for 2×MSL = 60 s on Linux, server → CLOSED)

name: m2-06-3
title: Congestion control
spec:
flowchart LR
  SS["Slow start\ncwnd +1 MSS per ACK → doubles per RTT"] -- "cwnd ≥ ssthresh" --> CA["Congestion avoidance\ncwnd +1 MSS per RTT (linear)"]
  CA -- "3 dup ACKs / SACK loss" --> FR["Fast retransmit + fast recovery\nssthresh = cwnd/2 (Reno) ; cwnd = ssthresh"]
  FR --> CA
  CA -- "RTO" --> RTO["ssthresh = cwnd/2 ; cwnd = 1-10 MSS"]
  RTO --> SS
  SS -- "loss" --> FR

name: m2-06-4
title: A diagnostic flow
spec:
flowchart TD
  Q["TCP symptom"] --> A{"Can connect?"}
  A -- "refused" --> A1["No listener / reject rule: ss -tlnp on server; check bind address (127.0.0.1 vs 0.0.0.0)"]
  A -- "timeout" --> A2["SYN dropped: tcpdump both ends; routing, SG/NSG/firewall, rp_filter, listen queue (nstat)"]
  A -- "connects" --> B{"Throughput low?"}
  B -- "yes" --> B1{"ss -ti: which limit?"}
  B1 -- "cwnd_limited / retrans" --> B2["Loss/congestion: path counters, drops at NIC/switch, CC algorithm, ECN"]
  B1 -- "rwnd_limited / zero window" --> B3["Receiver app slow or buffer too small: app profile, rmem"]
  B1 -- "sndbuf_limited" --> B4["Increase wmem or fix app write pattern"]
  B1 -- "app_limited" --> B5["Application not sending enough: look at the app"]
  B -- "no, but latency spikes" --> C["Nagle+delayed ACK, RTO events, accept queue, GC pauses, conntrack, bufferbloat (tcp_notsent_lowat)"]
  B -- "resets" --> D["Idle timeouts on LB/NAT/firewall; app crash; keepalives; RST source IP/TTL in tcpdump"]

name: m2-07-1
title: traceroute, tracepath and mtr
spec:
sequenceDiagram
  participant H as Host
  participant R1 as Router 1
  participant R2 as Router 2
  participant D as Destination
  H->>R1: probe TTL=1
  R1-->>H: ICMP time exceeded (from R1)
  H->>R2: probe TTL=2 (R1 forwards, TTL→1)
  R2-->>H: ICMP time exceeded (from R2)
  H->>D: probe TTL=3
  D-->>H: port unreachable / echo reply / SYN-ACK (end)

name: m2-07-2
title: MTU, MSS, fragmentation and Path MTU Discovery

  participant B as Receiver

  R-->>A: ICMP type 3 code 4 "need frag", next-hop MTU 1400
  Note over A: cache path MTU 1400 for B, retransmit smaller segments
  A->>R: 1400-byte packets
  R->>B: forwarded

name: m2-08-2
title: How a lookup actually works
spec:
sequenceDiagram
  participant App as Application
  participant Stub as Stub resolver (libc / systemd-resolved)
  participant Rec as Recursive resolver (cache)
  participant Root as Root server
  participant TLD as .com TLD server
  participant Auth as example.com authoritative
  App->>Stub: getaddrinfo("www.example.com")
  Stub->>Rec: query www.example.com A (recursion desired)
  Note over Rec: cache miss
  Rec->>Root: www.example.com A ?
  Root-->>Rec: referral: NS for com (+ glue)
  Rec->>TLD: www.example.com A ?
  TLD-->>Rec: referral: NS for example.com (+ glue)
  Rec->>Auth: www.example.com A ?
  Auth-->>Rec: A 93.184.216.34, TTL 300 (aa)
  Rec-->>Stub: answer (cached for 300 s)
  Stub-->>App: address

name: m2-08-3
title: How a Linux host resolves names
spec:
flowchart TD
  A["Application: getaddrinfo()"] --> N{"/etc/nsswitch.conf\nhosts: files mdns4_minimal [NOTFOUND=return] dns"}
  N -- "files" --> F["/etc/hosts"]
  N -- "dns" --> R{"/etc/resolv.conf"}
  R -- "nameserver 127.0.0.53" --> SR["systemd-resolved stub\n(per-link DNS, caching, DNSSEC, split DNS)"]
  R -- "nameserver 10.0.0.2 (direct)" --> RR["Recursive resolver"]
  SR --> RR
  RR --> I["Internet / authoritative"]

name: m2-08-4
title: Diagnosing DNS problems
spec:
flowchart TD
  S["Name doesn't resolve / slow"] --> G{"getent hosts NAME works?"}
  G -- "no" --> D{"dig NAME @resolver works?"}
  G -- "yes but app fails" --> A["App-level: own resolver/cache (JVM, nginx), IPv6-first AAAA failing, proxy settings, search path"]
  D -- "no: timeout" --> T["Resolver unreachable: routing, firewall UDP/TCP 53, wrong nameserver, MTU/fragmentation, overloaded resolver"]
  D -- "no: NXDOMAIN" --> N["Record missing/typo/negative cache/wrong zone/split-horizon view; dig +trace"]
  D -- "no: SERVFAIL" --> V["Upstream/auth server broken, lame delegation, DNSSEC failure (try +cd), forwarder down"]
  D -- "yes" --> L["Local path issue: nsswitch.conf order, /etc/hosts override, search/ndots expansion, systemd-resolved link config"]

name: m2-09-1
title: DORA
spec:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client (0.0.0.0, UDP 68)
  participant S as DHCP server (UDP 67)
  C->>S: DISCOVER (broadcast 255.255.255.255) "any DHCP server out there?"
  S-->>C: OFFER  yiaddr=10.20.0.45, lease 12h, options
  C->>S: REQUEST (broadcast) "I accept 10.20.0.45 from server X"
  S-->>C: ACK  (lease confirmed)
  Note over C: configures address, routes, DNS
  C->>S: (at T1 = 50% of lease) REQUEST unicast: renew
  S-->>C: ACK (new lease)
  C->>S: (at T2 = 87.5%) REQUEST broadcast: rebind to any server
  C->>S: (before leaving) RELEASE

name: m2-10-1
title: The handshake (TLS 1.3)
spec:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant S as Server
  C->>S: ClientHello: versions, random, cipher suites, key_share (X25519 public), SNI, ALPN (h2, http/1.1), supported_groups, signature_algorithms
  S->>C: ServerHello: chosen cipher suite + key_share (server public)
  Note over C,S: both derive handshake keys via ECDHE → everything after this is encrypted
  S->>C: EncryptedExtensions (ALPN result), Certificate (chain), CertificateVerify (signature over transcript), Finished
  C->>S: (Certificate + CertificateVerify if mutual TLS) Finished
  Note over C,S: application keys derived, app data flows (1-RTT total)
  C->>S: HTTP request

name: m2-14-1
title: Neighbour formation
spec:
sequenceDiagram
  participant A as IS A
  participant B as IS B
  A->>B: IIH (neighbours heard: none), hold time, padded to MTU
  B->>A: IIH (neighbours heard: A), hold time, padded to MTU
  Note over A: sees itself... A lists B in next hello → both two-way (3-way handshake, RFC 5303)
  B->>A: CSNP: summary of every LSP in B's database
  A->>B: PSNP: request for LSPs A lacks or has older
  Note over B: sets SRM (Send Route Message) flag for requested LSPs
  B->>A: LSPs (flooded)

name: m2-14-2
title: Neighbour state machine
spec:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Down
  Down --> Init: hello received (no 2-way)
  Init --> TwoWay: my router ID seen in neighbour's hello
  TwoWay --> ExStart: (DR/BDR elected) decide to form adjacency
  ExStart --> Exchange: master/slave chosen, DBD sequence agreed
  Exchange --> Loading: DBDs exchanged, LSRs sent for missing LSAs
  Loading --> Full: databases synchronised
  Full --> Down: dead timer / BFD down

name: m2-15-2
title: Session establishment
spec:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Idle
  Idle --> Connect: start event, TCP SYN to peer:179
  Connect --> Active: TCP failed, retry
  Active --> Connect: retry timer
  Connect --> OpenSent: TCP up, send OPEN
  Active --> OpenSent: TCP up, send OPEN
  OpenSent --> OpenConfirm: OPEN received, send KEEPALIVE
  OpenConfirm --> Established: KEEPALIVE received
  Established --> Idle: NOTIFICATION / hold timer expiry / TCP reset

name: m2-19-2
title: PFC: lossless links by backpressure
spec:

  participant R as Receiving switch (ingress buffer)
